sessions.phase_label: Concept development, revisions, and production-file delivery

requirements.title: Zebra Repeat Print
requirements.definition: Production of the independently selected zebra repeat artwork, including its stripe direction, scale, colour treatment, texture, contrast, and edge or border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: The zebra artwork has selections and revisions independent of the basket-weave and block-colour designs. Scale, palette, stripe direction, texture, and border treatment are attributes of this one print.

requirements.title: Diagonal Basket-Weave Repeat Print
requirements.definition: Production of the diagonal basket-weave repeat artwork with the requested handcrafted woven texture, diamond scale, tonal treatment, irregularity, and edge or border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: The basket-weave print evolves separately from the zebra print. Diamond size, woven texture, colour, grain, and border treatment are attributes of the single repeat-design mechanism.

requirements.title: Mustard Block-Colour Pareo
requirements.definition: Production of the mustard block-colour pareo variant with its independently correct interior colour, contrasting border, and selected border width.
requirements.boundary_note: The two block-colour pareos are separate output files that can be corrected independently. This Requirement covers only the mustard-interior variant; the presentation-file name associated with it requires confirmation.

requirements.title: Terracotta Block-Colour Pareo
requirements.definition: Production of the terracotta or burgundy block-colour pareo variant with its independently correct interior colour, contrasting border, and selected border width.
requirements.boundary_note: This is separate from the mustard block-colour pareo because each is a distinct production file whose colour placement and border execution can succeed or fail independently.

requirements.title: Pareo Artwork Dimensions and Seam Allowance
requirements.definition: The required finished dimensions, production-canvas dimensions, and seam allowance to be applied consistently to the pareo artwork files.
requirements.boundary_note: Canvas size and seam allowance form one tightly coupled production-geometry mechanism. They are separate from visual print design because the files can be resized without changing the underlying patterns.

requirements.title: Print-Ready File Specifications
requirements.definition: Delivery of supplier-usable production artwork with the required print format, resolution, CMYK preparation, fabric-appropriate colour handling, and documented colour references.
requirements.boundary_note: Format, resolution, CMYK mode, ICC calibration, and Pantone or CMYK references are treated as parameters of one production-readiness obligation rather than separate Requirements. Artwork dimensions are separate because they later undergo an independent resize trajectory.

unresolved_candidates.description: The evidence does not unambiguously map the presentation label 'Tela Mare _ 3' or the Rooibos Tea and Sudan Brown names to the mustard and terracotta block-colour Requirement IDs. The correction clearly concerns the mustard-interior variant, but exact file-name routing needs review.

The client selected the smaller Zebra Noir version for final artwork, while the final-delivery message names a Zebra Savanna tile. Audit should determine whether this is a naming-only issue, a delivery mismatch, or evidence of an unresolved zebra-direction conflict.
